summary: Lists requirements for the Path Computation Element Communication Protocol for inter-area MPLS and GMPLS traffic engineering. In multi-area networks, a head-end router cannot compute a constrained path across areas, so a path computation element can help. It is informational.

eli5.summary: One router only sees its own neighborhood and cannot plan a trip across town. This note says what a helper must do to plan it.
